cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules | tail -n +50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui
cd /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.318/62aaf1a860d71d7f310a9b0cd64bdc4c/dataviz && cat references/palette.md references/marks-and-anatomy.md references/interaction.md | head -400

cat /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.318/62aaf1a860d71d7f310a9b0cd64bdc4c/dataviz/references/anti-patterns.md | head -120; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -oE "export \{ default as (Grip|GripHorizontal|Xmark|Plus|ArrowRotateLeft|ArrowsRotateLeft|Pencil|Lock|LockOpen|ChevronsExpandToLines|ArrowUpRightFromSquare|Check|LayoutCells|SquareDashed|TrashBin|ArrowUp|ArrowDown|ArrowRotateLeft)\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts

for c in Card Button Icon Switch SegmentedRadioGroup DropdownMenu Text Label Table Popup Tooltip ActionTooltip Checkbox Flex; do printf "%s: " $c; grep -c "export \* from './$c'\|export { *$c\b\|\b$c\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; done; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && sed -n 1,80p DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts | grep -n "items\|renderSwitcher\|switcher\|Props" | head -20; grep -n "items\|action\|text\|disabled\|hidden" DropdownMenu/types.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "interface\|options\|size\|value\|onUpdate" SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head; grep -n "content\|onUpdate\|checked\|children" Switch/Switch.d.ts controls/types.d.ts | head; grep -rn "export interface TableColumnConfig" -A 30 Table/Table.d.ts | head -40
cat controls/types.d.ts | sed -n 30,80p; cat SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; grep -n "ControlGroupProps" -A 15 types.d.ts | head -25; cd /home/sandbox/workspace

cd /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.318/62aaf1a860d71d7f310a9b0cd64bdc4c/dataviz && node scripts/validate_palette.js "#2a78d6,#eb6834,#1baf7a,#eda100,#e87ba4" --mode light 2>&1 | tail -25; grep -n "onUpdate\|checked" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head
npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -25

for v in base-generic line-brand base-selection line-generic-accent line-generic base-float text-positive text-danger text-secondary text-primary text-complementary base-background base-generic-hover base-misc-light; do printf "%s " $v; grep -c -- "--g-color-$v:" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css; done

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && sed -n 1,40p DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts; grep -c -- "--g-color-line-focus:" ../../../styles/styles.css; grep -n "theme\|size\|icon" Label/Label.d.ts | head; grep -n "verticalAlign\|wordWrap\|emptyMessage\|className" Table/Table.d.ts | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -oE "export \{ default as (ChartColumn|LayoutRows|Table|ListUl|ChartLine|ArrowRotateLeft|Pencil|Plus)\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30
which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome firefox 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls -g 2>/dev/null | head; ls /usr/lib/node_modules 2>/dev/null
mkdir -p /tmp/shot && cd /tmp/shot && npm init -y >/dev/null && timeout 120 npm i playwright@1 2>&1 | tail -2 && timeout 300 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -3
sudo -n true 2>&1 && echo SUDO_OK; id -u; which apt-get
cd /tmp/shot && timeout 120 npm i vitest@3 jsdom@26 2>&1 | tail -1

cd /tmp/shot && sed -i 's#await import(.@gravity-ui/uikit.)#await import("/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.js")#' test/app.test.ts && grep -n "uikit" test/app.test.ts && ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.js && npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -v "^\s*$" | tail -40

pkill -f "vite preview" ; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -3 && npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests|passed|failed" ; (cd /tmp/shot && npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests ") ; rm -rf dist && git status --short
for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do if grep -q "vite.*preview" $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null; then kill ${p#/proc/} && echo killed ${p#/proc/}; fi; done
for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *preview*) echo "${p#/proc/} $c"; kill ${p#/proc/};; esac; done; echo done
ls /proc | grep -E '^(4387|4401|4402)$' || echo "preview server stopped"
kill 4402 4387 2>&1; sleep 1; ls /proc | grep -E '^(4387|4401|4402)$' || echo "preview server stopped"
cat /proc/4402/status | grep -E "State|PPid"; kill -9 4402 4387; sleep 1; ls /proc | grep -E '^(4387|4402)$' || echo "preview server stopped"
